title: The 3 Best Window Air Conditioners Under $400
h1: The 3 Best Window Air Conditioners Under $400
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for window air conditioners under $400, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at window air conditioners under $400 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea 8,000 BTU U-Shaped Smart Inverter Window Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU inverter compressor, Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft, As low as 32 dBA on low fan.
strengths: 37% efficiency gain lowers the electric bill over a full cooling season
U-shaped frame lets the window lock down for added security
limitations: Installation across the sash takes longer than a standard slide-in unit
Midea's 2025 recall and repair program covers some early U-shaped units over a mold-related drain issue
features: Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft
As low as 32 dBA on low fan
37% more efficient than the federal minimum standard
Typically $230 to $400 depending on sale timing

products.name: LG 8,000 BTU Smart Window Air Conditioner LW8017ERSM1
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU cooling capacity, Cools rooms up to 340 sq ft, LG ThinQ Wi-Fi app control.
strengths: LG ThinQ app adds remote scheduling that some pricier fixed-speed units skip
340 sq ft coverage handles most bedrooms and smaller living rooms
limitations: Fixed-speed compressor is louder at full cooling than the inverter units in this list
No U-shaped or flex-depth frame for a tighter window seal
features: Cools rooms up to 340 sq ft

products.name: Frigidaire 8,000 BTU Smart Inverter Window Air Conditioner FHWW085WE1
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU inverter compressor, Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft, 6-way directional airflow.
strengths: Inverter compressor at a price close to the LG's fixed-speed unit
6-way vents throw air further across a wider room than a fixed 2-way vent
PureAir washable filter is simple to maintain
limitations: Fewer long-term owner reviews than the LG or Midea
42 dBA is the highest rated noise figure among the inverter units in this list
features: Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
